skill.name: context-degradation
skill.description: Diagnoses context degradation in long AI sessions and explains mitigation patterns for lost-in-middle behavior, context poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash.
skill.summary: Identify context failure patterns and choose mitigation strategies for long AI agent sessions.
skill.author: muratcankoylan

content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can hide important context and cause agents to answer incorrectly. This skill helps identify degradation patterns and choose mitigation strategies for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle, context poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash patterns.
Provides guidance for placing critical information near attention-favored positions.
Describes mitigation strategies including compaction, masking, retrieval filtering, and task isolation.
Includes a Python utility for estimating context health and detecting degradation indicators.
Supplies examples for monitoring token growth and organizing long-context inputs.
limitations: The detector uses heuristic text analysis and simulated attention estimates, not model internals.
It does not automatically rewrite prompts or modify production systems.
Benchmark thresholds in the documentation may become outdated as models change.
It requires users to supply context details and validate recommendations against real outcomes.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Identify whether degraded answers come from lost-in-middle effects, poisoning, distraction, confusion, or conflicting context.

use_cases.title: Review Retrieval Pipelines
use_cases.description: Evaluate how retrieved documents enter context and reduce the risk of irrelevant or outdated information affecting results.

use_cases.title: Plan Context Architecture
use_cases.description: Choose when to compress, filter, isolate, or externalize context before agents reach unreliable operating ranges.

prompt_templates.title: Identify the Pattern
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis of a failed long conversation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent failure and identify the most likely context degradation pattern. Explain the evidence and suggest one mitigation.

prompt_templates.title: Check Lost-in-Middle Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze placement of important information in a long prompt or transcript.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find critical facts that may be buried in the middle of this context. Recommend where to move or repeat them.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Mitigation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a practical plan for a context-heavy workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this agent workflow, propose a context strategy using write, select, compress, and isolate techniques. Include tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Context Health
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a deployed agent system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this production agent trace for degradation risks. Separate evidence, likely root causes, measurement gaps, and remediation priorities.

output_examples.input: A support agent starts accurate but later ignores the original escalation rule.
output_examples.output: Likely context poisoning or context confusion. The next step is to locate when the incorrect rule entered the conversation and restart from verified instructions.

output_examples.input: A long research prompt includes the key requirement halfway through the document.
output_examples.output: Lost-in-middle risk is high. Move the requirement to the task opening, repeat it near the final instructions, and shorten supporting material.

output_examples.input: A retrieval system adds many similar documents with different dates.
output_examples.output: Context clash is likely. Add version filtering, mark conflicts explicitly, and define source priority before documents enter the context window.

best_practices: Track context length, task type, and observed failures together.
Place critical instructions at the beginning or end of context.
Filter, summarize, or isolate context before it becomes too large.
anti_patterns: Loading every retrieved document into context without relevance filtering.
Treating a larger context window as a replacement for context design.
Keeping outdated, contradictory, or unverified information in active context.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps diagnose why AI agents degrade during long sessions and how to reduce that risk.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is model-agnostic and is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the Python script inspect my system?
faq.answer: No. The included script analyzes supplied context text with local heuristics and simulated attention estimates.

faq.question: Can it prove that context poisoning occurred?
faq.answer: No. It identifies indicators and likely causes, but users must verify claims against trusted evidence.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when long prompts, retrieved documents, or extended agent sessions start producing inconsistent results.

faq.question: What mitigation strategy is usually most effective?
faq.answer: Filtering and isolating context are often strongest because they prevent irrelevant material from entering the active window.
